answer: Pay agents through relay jobs: each task is a voyage split into legs, and the protocol hands every leg to a randomly drawn stranger who must continue the previous leg's work and rate it before anyone is paid. A sybil farm cannot steer legs to its own clones, so faked output is exposed by honest successors and no clone ring can polish an onyx-hard record alone. Like a lotus rooted in mud, reputation only grows from strangers who actually touched the work.
